author: J. C. Ryle
title_tet: Hanoin Sira Ba Joven Mane Sira
subtitle_en: Pastoral Counsel on Guarding Youth, Resisting Temptation, and Serving God Today
subtitle_tet: Konsellu Pastorál Kona-Ba Kuidadu Juventude, Kontra Tentasaun no Serbí Maromak Ohin

cards.section_heading_en: Introduction - Special Appeal to Young Men
cards.section_heading_tet: Introdusaun - Apelu Espesiál Ba Joven Mane Sira
cards.scripture_en: "Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth" (Eccl 12:1).
cards.scripture_tet: "Hanoin-hetan Ó-nia Kriadór agora iha loron sira ó-nia juventude nian" (Eclesiastes 12:1).
cards.body_en: Young men, I entreat you to listen to the words of pastoral advice. Youth is the most impressionable season of life, the seedtime of your future eternity. I write to warn you, to encourage you, and to urge you to dedicate your life to God now. Break away from sin and serve God immediately, before habits harden your heart.
cards.body_tet: Joven mane sira, ha'u husu ho laran-tomak atu imi rona liafuan konsellu pastorál sira. Juventude mak tempu moris nian ne'ebé fasil liu atu simu influénsia, tempu kari fini ba imi-nia eternidade iha futuru. Ha'u hakerek atu fó avizu ba imi, atu enkoraja imi, no atu husu maka'as atu imi dedika imi-nia moris ba Maromak agora. Hakotu aan husi sala no serbí Maromak kedas, antes kostume sira halo imi-nia fuan toos.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Youth is the decisive seedtime for eternity; dedicate your life to God now before sinful habits harden the heart.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Juventude mak tempu kari fini ne'ebé desizivu ba eternidade; dedika ó-nia moris ba Maromak agora antes kostume sala halo fuan toos.

cards.section_heading_tet: Razaun Sira Atu Fó Avizu Ba Joven Mane Sira
cards.scripture_en: "For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ" (2 Cor 5:10).
cards.scripture_tet: "Tanba ita hotu tenke mosu iha kadeira julgamentu Kristu nian oin" (2 Korintu 5:10).
cards.body_en: Why must I warn you? Because your time is short, death is certain, and the Judgment Seat of Christ is before you! Many die in their youth; your health may be taken in a moment. Furthermore, Satan targets young men with special cunning, seeking to blind your eyes with worldly vanities and delay your repentance until it is too late.
cards.body_tet: Tanba sá mak ha'u tenke fó avizu ba imi? Tanba imi-nia tempu badak, mate mak serteza, no Kadeira Julgamentu Kristu nian iha imi-nia oin! Ema barak mate iha sira-nia juventude; imi-nia saúde bele lakon iha momentu ida. Aleinde ne'e, Satanás tarjetu joven mane sira ho matenek aat espesiál, hodi buka atu taka imi-nia matan ho vaidade mundu nian no demora imi-nia arrependimentu to'o tarde liu ona.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Life is brief, judgment is certain, and Satan schemes to delay youthful repentance with worldly vanities.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Moris badak, julgamentu serteza, no Satanás planeia atu demora arrependimentu juventude nian ho vaidade mundu nian.

cards.scripture_en: "The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe" (Prov 29:25).
cards.scripture_tet: "Tauk ba ema lori lasu ida: maibé ema ne'ebé tau konfiansa iha NA'I sei seguru" (Provérbios 29:25).
cards.body_en: Beware of the special temptations of youth: 1. Pride and self-conceit. 2. Fleshly lusts and impurity—the 'young man's sin' (7th commandment). 3. Love of worldly pleasures and frivolity. 4. Fear of peer opinion ("What will people say?"). Fear of man brings a snare and leads to wretched spiritual slavery.
cards.body_tet: Kuidadu ba tentasaun espesiál sira juventude nian: 1. Foti-aan no hanoin aan boot. 2. Hakarak aat isin nian no impuresa—'sala joven mane nian' (mandamentu ba-7). 3. Domin ba ksolok mundanu no buat mamuk sira. 4. Tauk ba maluk sira-nia opiniaun ("Ema sei dehan saida?"). Tauk ba ema lori lasu ida no lori ba escravidaun espirituál ne'ebé terus.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Guard against pride, sexual impurity, worldly frivolity, and the fear of man that ensnares the soul.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Kuidadu hasoru foti-aan, impuresa seksuál, buat mamuk mundanu no tauk ba ema ne'ebé kaer klamar iha lasu.

cards.section_heading_en: Special Rule 1 - Break with Every Sin
cards.section_heading_tet: Regra Espesiál 1 - Hakotu Aan Husi Sala Hotu
cards.scripture_en: "A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump" (1 Cor 5:6).
cards.scripture_tet: "Fermantu uitoan halo masa tomak sa'e" (1 Korintu 5:6).
cards.body_en: Resolve at once, by God’s help, to break off every known sin, however small. A small leak will sink a great ship. "A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump" (1 Cor 5:6). Resist sin in its very beginnings. Show no mercy to 'little sins', for the devil only wants the wedge of a little allowed sin to claim your whole soul.
cards.body_tet: Rezolve kedas, ho Maromak nia ajuda, atu hakotu aan husi sala hotu ne'ebé hatene, maski ki'ik. Kuak ki'ik ida sei halo ró boot mout. "Fermantu uitoan halo masa tomak sa'e" (1 Korintu 5:6). Kontra sala iha ninia hahú rasik. Keta hatudu laran-sadia ba 'sala ki'ik sira', tanba diabu hakarak de'it fukun husi sala ki'ik ida ne'ebé permite atu hadau ó-nia klamar tomak.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Cut off every known sin immediately at its beginning; tolerated small sins sink the soul.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Hakotu sala hotu ne'ebé hatene kedas iha ninia hahú; sala ki'ik ne'ebé permite halo klamar mout.

cards.section_heading_en: Special Rule 2 - Avoid Every Occasion for Sin
cards.section_heading_tet: Regra Espesiál 2 - Sees Husi Okaziaun Hotu Ba Sala
cards.scripture_en: "Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace" (2 Tim 2:22).
cards.scripture_tet: "Halai sees mós husi hakarak aat juventude nian: maibé tuir justisa, fiar, karidade, dame" (2 Timóteo 2:22).
cards.body_en: Avoid every occasion for sin. Fly from bad company; do not linger near temptation. Follow the example of Joseph, who fled from Potiphar’s wife. He who would keep his soul clean must avoid the places, companions, and amusements that lead to sin. Do not give Satan vantage-ground.
cards.body_tet: Sees husi okaziaun hotu ba sala. Halai dok husi maluk aat sira; keta hela besik tentasaun. Tuir ezemplu José nian, ne'ebé halai sees husi Potifar nia feen. Ema ne'ebé hakarak rai ninia klamar moos tenke sees husi fatin, maluk no divertimentu sira ne'ebé lori ba sala. Keta fó vantajen ba Satanás.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Flee bad company and tempting environments like Joseph rather than lingering near danger.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Halai dok husi maluk aat no ambiente tentasaun nian hanesan José duké hela besik perigu.

cards.section_heading_en: Special Rule 3 - Make the Bible Your Guide & Remember God's Eye
cards.section_heading_tet: Regra Espesiál 3 - Halo Bíblia Sai Ó-Nia Matadalan no Hanoin Maromak Nia Matan
cards.scripture_en: "Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word" (Psa 119:9).
cards.scripture_tet: "Oinsá mak joven mane ida sei hamoos ninia dalan? Hodi kuidadu ida-ne'e tuir Ó-nia liafuan" (Salmu 119:9).
cards.body_en: Determine to make the Bible your guide and adviser. Read it with prayer, reverently, and regularly. Furthermore, never forget the all-seeing eye of God. Lock the door, draw the blinds—it matters not! God is everywhere; His eye beholds your most secret thoughts and actions. Live as seeing Him who is invisible.
cards.body_tet: Determina atu halo Bíblia sai ó-nia matadalan no konselleiru. Lee ida-ne'e ho orasaun, ho respeitu no ho regulár. Aleinde ne'e, keta haluha nunka matan Maromak nian ne'ebé haree buat hotu. Xave odamatan, taka kortina—la importa! Maromak iha fatin hotu; Ninia matan haree ó-nia hanoin no hahalok sira ne'ebé subar liu. Moris hanesan haree Nia ne'ebé matan la haree.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Let Scripture guide your daily steps and live constantly aware of God's all-seeing presence.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Husik Eskritura dirije ó-nia hakat loron-loron no moris nafatin ho konsiénsia kona-ba Maromak nia prezensa ne'ebé haree buat hotu.

cards.section_heading_en: Special Rule 4 - Use Means of Grace & Pray Daily
cards.section_heading_tet: Regra Espesiál 4 - Uza Meiu Grasa Nian no Harohan Loron-Loron
cards.body_en: Be diligent in the use of all public means of grace. Keep the Lord’s Day holy, and let your place in church never be empty under faithful preaching. Above all, resolve that wherever you are, YOU MUST PRAY! Prayer is the life-breath of the soul. No time is so well spent as that which a man spends upon his knees.
cards.body_tet: Sai badinas iha uza meiu públiku hotu grasa nian. Rai Na'i nia Loron santu, no husik ó-nia fatin iha igreja nunka mamuk iha pregasaun fiél nia okos. Liu buat hotu, rezolve katak iha fatin naran de'it ne'ebé ó iha, Ó TENKE HAROHAN! Orasaun mak iis moris nian ba klamar. La iha tempu ne'ebé uza ho di'ak liu duké tempu ne'ebé ema gasta iha ninia ain-tuur.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Honor the Lord's Day, sit faithfully under God's Word, and maintain daily prayer as the breath of the soul.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Respeita Na'i nia Loron, tuur ho fiél iha Maromak nia Liafuan okos, no mantein orasaun loron-loron nu'udar iis klamar nian.

cards.section_heading_en: Conclusion - Today Is God’s Day, Do Not Delay
cards.section_heading_tet: Konkluzaun - Ohin Mak Maromak Nia Loron, Keta Demora
cards.scripture_en: "Behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation" (2 Cor 6:2).
cards.scripture_tet: "Haree bá, agora mak tempu ne'ebé simu; haree bá, agora mak loron salvasaun nian" (2 Korintu 6:2).
cards.body_en: Tomorrow is the devil’s day, but TODAY is God’s. Do not reckon on a late repentance; late repentance is seldom true. Young men, you are wanted for God! A wide field of usefulness is open before you. Awake to a sense of sin, seek to know the greatness of Christ, and give your youth to Him today!
cards.body_tet: Aban mak diabu nia loron, maibé OHIN mak Maromak nian. Keta konta ba arrependimentu tarde; arrependimentu tarde raru mak loos. Joven mane sira, Maromak presiza imi! Kampu luan ida atu sai útil nakloke iha imi-nia oin. Hadeer ba sentidu sala nian, buka atu hatene Kristu nia boot, no fó imi-nia juventude ba Nia ohin!
cards.key_takeaway_en: Tomorrow is the devil's day, today is God's—come to Christ now and devote your youth to His service.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Aban mak diabu nia loron, ohin mak Maromak nian—mai ba Kristu agora no dedika ó-nia juventude ba Ninia servisu.

infographic.title_en: Four Practical Rules for Guarding Youth
infographic.title_tet: Regra Prátika Haat Atu Kuidadu Juventude
steps_en: 1. Break immediately with every known sin, however small
2. Flee bad company and every occasion that leads to temptation
3. Make the Bible your daily guide and remember God's all-seeing eye
4. Honor the Lord's Day, attend preaching, and pray daily without fail
steps_tet: 1. Hakotu kedas husi sala hotu ne'ebé hatene, maski ki'ik
2. Halai dok husi maluk aat no okaziaun hotu ne'ebé lori ba tentasaun
3. Halo Bíblia sai matadalan loron-loron no hanoin Maromak nia matan
4. Respeita Na'i nia Loron, tuir pregasaun, no harohan loron-loron sein falla
